verdict.rationale: Together AI documents an official Docs MCP server that gives coding agents live access to its documentation site, alongside 12 agent skills, and a probe confirms the agent-skills page exists. However, this MCP server only covers docs lookup. Nothing shows it exposes platform actions such as inference, fine-tuning, endpoint deployment or batch jobs, so an agent can connect but cannot operate Together AI through it. Missing for 10: an MCP server exposing platform/API operations (models, endpoints, fine-tuning), setup and auth details for connecting agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.
